ألتهم (form VIII)
# أَلْتَهِمُ (ʔaltahimu) /ʔal.ta.hi.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
# أُلْتَهَمُ (ʔultahamu) /ʔul.ta.ha.mu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
# أَلْتَهِمَ (ʔaltahima) /ʔal.ta.hi.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
# أُلْتَهَمَ (ʔultahama) /ʔul.ta.ha
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
